verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26717492 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318637 (2026-03-17). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,500 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-04-27. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps, and no document date.
red_flags: Terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays these, so the invoice may carry extra charges.
The document shows no issue date of its own. The only date besides the confirmed delivery date is the PO date of 2026-03-17.
The Qty column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed. It is recorded here as quantity_confirmed.
observations: Clean printed single-page document; no handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs.
The description wraps over three lines ('Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5').
No total price or currency total is shown.
